output.reason: The brief backs its claim with two natural experiments: aps-3 got 5.8 but skipped the config push and stayed fast, and rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. Its timing also fits the evidence and keeps the security fix, though it leaves backlog growth (probably Orrin's ingest) unresolved and puts off throttling.
